reuse.why: getNextDate gets the new daily rule, but getUpcomingDates writes its own skip-weekdays branch instead of going through a shared occurrence-adjustment helper, and schedule-template recomputes the daily condition itself.

duplication.why: The 'skipWeekend && daily' rule and the filter-out-weekends lookahead are written separately in shared getNextDate, server getUpcomingDates and the budget schedule-template, each with its own lookahead limit.

placement.why: The rule belongs in shared/schedules.ts next to getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but parts of it are also placed in the server handler and the budget template.

scope.why: Touches only the weekend-handling paths plus a test and release note; the rule-utils frequency field is needed for the shared check.

maintainability.why: Three independent copies of the daily rule must stay in sync, and schedule-template passes a variable named moveWeekends into getNextDate's noSkipWeekend parameter, which is hard to follow.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and server/budget/schedule-template.ts createScheduleList decide the daily weekend rule themselves instead of through getNextDate/shared helper.

disguised_duplication.where: getUpcomingDates' filter(!isWeekend).slice(count) branch with count*7+14 lookahead re-states getNextDate's find(isWeekday) with DAILY_LOOKAHEAD; schedule-template's moveWeekends expression restates the same frequency condition.

one_place.where: Daily-skip rule lives in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate, server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and server/budget/schedule-template.ts (moveWeekends).
